secondary_zero_shot.clipping_rule: y_pred = np.clip(raw_unscaled_pred, 0.0, 10.0) ** 2 (clamps sqrt(porosity) at 10.0, representing 100% void ceiling to prevent polynomial overflow)

in_range_subset.description: Ti specimens with pore% <= 1.74% (max void fraction in steel training set)
in_range_subset.finding: Failure persists inside training range; proves domain void extrapolation is not the sole cause

bias_corrected.description: Residual offset subtracted using held-out 10% calibration specimens
bias_corrected.finding: Mean brightness offset accounts for substantial bias but negative correlation persists

scale_matched.description: Resampled input scale from 2.2325 um/px to 2.16 um/px (0.967x factor)
scale_matched.finding: Scale resampling yields negligible effect (<0.5% shift); spatial resolution mismatch is not the root cause

diagnostics.physical_root_cause: Background matrix reflectance offset (+55 grayscale intensity between Ackermann steel [187] and Ti-6Al-4V [242]) and domain truncation [0.0%, 1.74%] vs [0.0%, 49.4%]. Etching difference ruled out because both sets are unetched.

old_config.frozen_layers: Backbone frozen in head_only mode; all layers unfrozen in full mode
old_config.baseline_control: None (No ImageNet-init control benchmarked under identical conditions)

new_config.frozen_layers: All layers unfrozen (full fine-tuning for both Steel-Init and ImageNet-Init)
new_config.baseline_control: ImageNet-init (tf_efficientnetv2_s) evaluated on identical 10%, 25%, 50% data subsets, same folds, and same seeds
